name: AN2 Therapeutics, Inc.
summary: AN2 Therapeutics, Inc., a biopharmaceutical company, focuses on discovering and developing novel small molecule therapeutics. The company's initial candidate includes epetraborole, which is phase 3 clinical trial as a once-daily oral treatment for patients with non-tuberculous mycobacterial lung disease, as well as studying for the treatment of acute melioidosis. It also develops AN2-502998 (AN15368), an investigational, boron-based small molecule in development for the treatment of chronic Chagas disease that is in preclinical trials; and has various research programs targeting the development of novel compounds in oncology and infectious disease based on its boron chemistry platform.
